experiment: P6 local posterior-JS information-gain oracle v1
motivation: replace future/reference/EOS-derived H4 utility with a local dense training target that asks whether the center bonus changes the ISLR posterior

target.score: symmetric Jensen-Shannon divergence in natural-log units between the softmax ISLR posteriors at offset0 and offset2
target.score_visibility: training target observes the offset2 posterior but no reference, decoder continuation, future beyond offset2, or true EOS
target.intended_predictor_deadline: after offset0 and before paying for offset2

policies.hard_skeleton: select offset0 in every block including an incomplete tail
policies.bonus_budget: for B complete blocks retain K=ceil(B/2) offset2 bonuses
policies.uniform_sparse: choose K block indices floor((j+0.5)*B/K), j=0..K-1
policies.js_oracle: choose the K largest local JS scores; ties use earlier block index
policies.full_center_control: offset0 plus offset2 in every complete block
policies.per_sample_equal_budget: uniform_sparse and js_oracle must select exactly the same number of windows

primary_comparison.metric: final train-fit WER of JS oracle versus equal-budget uniform_sparse

integrity: JS and uniform sparse have equal selected-window counts for every sample
gates.decision: both relevance gates plus all integrity gates must pass before any causal predictor for local JS information gain

forbidden: calibration, dev, test, held-out, or closed-loop outcomes
changing the score, 50 percent bonus retention, uniform placement, decoder, threshold, or gates after outcomes
claiming deployability: the oracle observes the candidate offset2 posterior and uses known sample block count for exact budgeting
